Team,

Sharing the proposed executive hiring slate we discussed in the leadership offsite. This is intentionally tight — we need final approvals by EOD Thu 11 Jul to hit offer windows and our preferred start dates in Q3. Highlights: 

- Roles (4): VP Sales, Head of Reliability, Head of Product (external hire if internal pass), Director of Legal (senior)
- Rationale: sales coverage for enterprise motion, reliability lead to accelerate infra roadmap, product leader to own roadmap and GTM alignment, legal to support enterprise contracts and privacy.
- Budget impact: net add of 3 FTEs in headcount (we expect an internal promotion for one slot) with incremental OPEX and equity. See attached spreadsheet for comp bands and run-rate impact.

Attachments: 2028-Q3-exec-hc-slate.xlsx, comp-bands-2028Q3.pdf

Please review the slate and the comp bands. Specific asks:
1) Approve the slate as-is, or flag any role you want removed/held.
2) Sign off on the comp band ranges in the attached PDF (noted on tab 'Bands - Exec').
3) If you need justification for VP Sales comp uplift (we've shown two scenarios), let me know and I will attach the benchmark memo.

If I don't hear objections, I'll proceed to instruct TalentPartners to surface final candidates and to prepare offers (DocuSign links to follow).

Thanks — Rohan

--
